summary: Executed backend + frontend schedule regression against public URL. Core GET/save/generate/fill/auth-guard flows pass, but all date-based PATCH panel writes fail with 422, breaking admin move/add/drag workflows in UI.

critical.issue: Valid date payloads are rejected with 422 (`none_required` for body.date). Reproduced for same-day edit, legal move, duplicate-mold test, and full-day test where 409 was expected.

minor.issue: Auth playbook file referenced by process is missing in repository.

ui_bugs.issue: Date edit/add failures show generic `Error de solicitud (422)` instead of conflict-specific guidance requested for daily detail/manual move conflicts.

integration_issues.flow: Admin daily detail: change date / remove to pending then add
integration_issues.issue: Remove (date=null) works, but re-add with date always fails 422 due backend date validation bug; schedule drift observed (scheduled 525->524, unscheduled 1->2 during test).
Frontend drag interaction triggers, but backend PATCH date writes are blocked by same 422 issue; persisted move cannot be guaranteed.

action_items: Fix MoveRequest date typing in backend model (`backend/scheduling/models.py`) so ISO dates are accepted (currently parsed as None-only).
Re-run schedule PATCH conflict matrix after fix: legal move=200, duplicate mold/day=409, full global day=409, Sunday/before-start/far-future=422.
Improve frontend schedule error mapping for 422/409 list-style validation payloads to show meaningful user guidance in daily detail and DnD flows.
Add missing /app/auth_testing.md or update process docs to remove broken reference.
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause is in `backend/scheduling/models.py`: `date` type is imported as `from datetime import date`, then field is declared `date: Optional[date] = None`, creating name shadowing in class scope and causing Pydantic to treat the field annotation as self-reference/None-required in validation.
`ScheduleService.snapshot()` preview logic is deterministic and respects source reconciliation (stale entries excluded by object_name + molde match).
Schedule API responses correctly avoid Mongo `_id` exposure.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (navigation/role/read-only/responsive passed; admin date-write integrations failed due backend PATCH bug)

test_credentials: Admin password `admin2026` from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; viewer via role-viewer-button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After tests, production schedule doc was explicitly reset by deleting `_id=production` so current public GET /api/schedule returns saved=false, revision=0, start_date=2026-11-01, daily_capacity=5, scheduled=526, unscheduled=0; /api/report/molds summary remains baseline total=526 assigned=526 model_total=533.
rca of the issue: Repro: POST /api/admin/verify (ok token) -> GET /api/schedule -> PATCH /api/schedule/panel with valid `{object_name, date:'YYYY-MM-DD', revision}` returns 422 with detail `type=none_required`, `loc=['body','date']`, `msg='Input should be None'`. Any date string path (manual date edit, add pending to day, DnD drop) fails. Mitigation: rename imported type (e.g., `import datetime as dt` then `date: Optional[dt.date]`) or use postponed annotations/string annotations to avoid field/type name collision; then rerun CAS + conflict tests.
